ModMetaData.name: Yuran Fur Shaved For RJW
ModMetaData.author: zoc2k
ModMetaData.description:
Texture replacement patch for the Yuran race in RJW addon mods. It swaps the fur on Yuran body and genital textures for a shaved variant.
Every target mod is optional. Folders are gated by LoadFolders.xml, so nothing is loaded for a mod you do not have installed, and no error is produced.
Target mods: - Rimworld Hawkeye32's RJW Animations (Hawkeye32.Hawks.Anims) - Multiple Races SA0 Patch (adk.sar.alien) - RJW Animations adjusts HAR race offset (Talos.RJW.Animations.adjusts.HAR.race.offset)
Load order: place this mod below RJW, HAR, the Yuran race mod, Sized Apparel, and all target mods. It contains textures only, so a wrong load order simply means the replacements are not applied.
This mod ships replacement textures only. No original assets from the target mods are redistributed. Unofficial, and not affiliated with the original authors.
